verdict.rationale: AI Gateway is an API-first service. The docs state that its API keys work in CI, on external servers and in local development (docs-40), and that OIDC tokens are injected automatically on Vercel deployments (docs-14). It is driven through OpenAI-compatible endpoints and SDKs with a URL swap (docs-28) and has a CLI setup command (docs-8), so it runs headlessly by design. Missing for 10: a dedicated CI/automation guide or examples (e.g., pipeline config), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
